entries.summary: New files: `common/src/ads/agentic-ad-lab-bench.ts`, `common/src/ads/sponsored-declared-installs.ts`, `common/src/ads/sponsored-skill-checks.ts`, `common/src/ads/sponsored-skill.ts` (+3 more).

ai.title: Add sponsored skill format, declared installs, and ad lab bench
ai.summary: The sponsored ads subsystem gains a skill format and a declared install gate: `sponsored-declared-installs.ts` lets a run install only the exact packages its skill declares, executing them with `--ignore-scripts` and `--save-exact` to skip lifecycle hooks. The CLI's `sponsored-run.ts` now resolves declared packages from the procedure hash and replaces the blanket install refusal with this check, while `sponsored-step-driver.ts` adds a harness-driven step loop that validates agent work against deterministic checks. The Agentic Ads Lab gains `agentic-ad-lab-bench.ts` with a pinned `LAB_BENCH` of 25 repositories and a `compareLabBatches` gate that blocks regression on any single repository, alongside raising `LAB_BATCH_MAX_REPOSITORIES` to 30 in `agentic-ad-lab-batch.ts`.
ai.evidence: The diff introduces `sponsored-declared-installs.ts` and `sponsored-skill.ts` in `common/src/ads/`, adds `agentic-ad-lab-bench.ts` with `LAB_BENCH`, and modifies `cli/src/utils/sponsored-run.ts` to use `evaluateSponsoredInstallCommand` for package installation checks.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the runtime consumer that calls `driveSponsoredSkillSteps` in a live sponsored session.

changes.what: Adds `sponsored-declared-installs.ts` to gate package installs to a skill's declared list with canonical `--ignore-scripts` commands.
Introduces `sponsored-skill.ts` defining the skill data format, parsing, validation, and hash-locking for advertiser procedures.
Adds `sponsored-step-driver.ts` and `sponsored-skill-checks.ts` to run a deterministic step loop that evaluates checks and prompts the agent to fix failures.
Updates `sponsored-run.ts` and `sponsored-agent.ts` to resolve declared packages from the procedure hash and replace the blanket install refusal with the new gate.
Adds `agentic-ad-lab-bench.ts` with a pinned `LAB_BENCH` of repositories and `compareLabBatches`, and raises `LAB_BATCH_MAX_REPOSITORIES` to 30 in `agentic-ad-lab-batch.ts`.

eli5.text: The automated system that runs paid tasks on a user's computer now allows the installation of specific software tools, but only when the task's written instructions explicitly list them by name and exact version. This narrow permission replaces the previous blanket ban on adding new tools, ensuring that hidden setup scripts never run and that the user's review of the changes remains complete. The internal testing suite also grew from ten to thirty sample projects, so the system can now check its work against a wider range of common software setups before a task is released to the public.

facts: Cards before the answer; see util/suggest-prompts-before-answer.ts.

A step that calls suggest_prompts with only a short lead-in ("Here's the plan.") gets one more step, with a note to write the answer, instead of ending the turn. Once per user prompt; cards beside a real answer still end it. Why and how it was measured: docs/freebuff-muse-spark.md.
Called when a step is about to end the turn. `history` already holds this step's calls, one message per call. A step at the suggestion cap is a runaway, which the cap ends.
entries.title: Agent Runtime update: run-agent-step
entries.summary: New files: `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/suggest-prompts-before-answer.ts`.

ai.title: Agent runtime nudges to write answer after suggest prompts cards
ai.summary: The agent runtime in packages/agent-runtime now prevents a turn from ending on `suggest_prompts` tool calls when the model's response text is shorter than 300 characters, which indicates the cards arrived before the substantive answer. The new `endsOnSuggestPromptsBeforeAnswer` utility in `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/suggest-prompts-before-answer.ts` scans the message history to ensure this nudge fires at most once per user prompt and not at all if the model has hit the `MAX_FOLLOWUP_SUGGESTION_CALLS_PER_RESPONSE` cap, which is treated as a runaway condition. When triggered, the runtime appends the `SUGGEST_PROMPTS_BEFORE_ANSWER_MESSAGE` to the history and forces the agent to take one more step to produce the missing plain text answer.
ai.evidence: The diff adds `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/suggest-prompts-before-answer.ts` containing `endsOnSuggestPromptsBeforeAnswer` and constants, and integrates the new utility into `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` to append a nudge message when a step ends on `suggest_prompts` cards without a full answer.

eli5.text: The assistant now waits for you to receive a full written answer before it stops working on a request, instead of stopping after showing you clickable follow-up suggestions. This helps you, as a user of the free or paid coding assistant, see the actual result or explanation you asked for in every conversation. You will notice that the chat no longer ends with just a short line and buttons; the complete text appears before the assistant moves on.

ai.title: Ad engagement schema gains viewable duration fields
ai.summary: The shared ad client context schema in `common` adds two optional millisecond fields to ad engagement records: `viewableMs` for cumulative time at 50% or greater intersection while the document is visible, and `focusedViewableMs` for the same interval while the window had focus. A new `DESKTOP_AD_DENSITY` analytics event is registered in the `common` package and marked as always-tracked in the sampling utility because density ratios rely on these summed disjoint durations. These additions allow the click model to receive finer-grained viewability data from desktop clients.

In `common/src/util/analytics-sampling.ts`, `DESKTOP_AD_DENSITY` is added to the `ALWAYS_TRACK_EVENTS` set.

ai.summary: A new `TURN_ENDING_NOTE` constant is introduced in `common` and conditionally injected as `instructionsPrompt` in the `base3` agent when the compiled model matches `FREEBUFF_MUSE_SPARK_13_CONTRIBUTOR_MODEL_ID`. The CLI catalog agent now passes the resolved `compiledModelId` to `createBase3CliRoot`, ensuring that opaque catalog handles correctly trigger the per-model behavior without breaking prompt caching for other models. In daily use, you will simply notice that the Muse Spark 1.3 model is less likely to stop working and just report progress; no action is required from you.
